summary: Iter 40 — Verified Iter 39 single fix: Tracking → MapView crash resolved when brokerage_bookings are merged into the shipment list. Frontend-only retest. Logged in via Quick Sign In on /login (admin token) → navigated to /tracking. Fix in pages/Tracking.jsx (a) tags converted booking rows with _noMap=true, (b) mapShipments now filters to require numeric origin.lat AND destination.lat. ALL 4 ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA PASS: (1) /tracking loads with ZERO lat/undefined runtime errors — no react-error-overlay; only an unrelated 'Invalid language tag: en-US@posix' console warning (mapbox locale, not from Tracking). (2) Brokerage bookings remain in the tracker list and are fully searchable — searching 'BK-8A6CB0889E' returns 1 match and the row [data-testid="tracker-row-BK-8A6CB0889E"] renders; searching carrier 'dff' also returns 1 match. (3) Real shipments with valid lat/lng still render as markers — Leaflet map rendered with ~53 markers visible. (4) 'Live Map · N shipments' counter shows only geocoded shipments: 53 on map vs 65 in tracker list (12 bookings excluded from map); when searching a booking-only term, map counter correctly drops to 0 while tracker count is 1.
critical_code_review_comments: Tracking.jsx mapShipments filter is now defensive (typeof origin.lat === 'number' && typeof destination.lat === 'number') — good belt-and-suspenders alongside _noMap flag; will also guard against any future shipment ingestion path that omits coords.

Minor: the 'Invalid language tag: en-US@posix' pageerror originates from a third-party (likely mapbox-gl or i18n lib) reading process.env.LANG or navigator.language. Non-blocking but worth a follow-up to normalize the locale tag before passing to Intl.* APIs.
Optional hardening (already noted in iter 39): wrapping MapView in an ErrorBoundary would prevent a single malformed marker row from ever blanking the /tracking page in the future.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 39 MapView crash fix verified end-to-end on the live preview env. The fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Tracking.jsx is robust: (a) bookings get _noMap=true sentinel, (b) mapShipments filter requires typeof origin.lat === 'number' && typeof destination.lat === 'number'. Counter math validated: 53 map markers + 12 booking-only rows = 65 active in tracker. Search across booking fields (booked_id, carrier_name) works as designed. No further action needed on the Tracking page; the iter 39 backend pytest regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter39_cash_flow.py remains the source-of-truth for /api/cash-flow/*.
rca of the issue: RCA confirmed and mitigated: prior crash was MapView's marker .map(s => ... s.origin.lat) hitting undefined on booking-shaped rows. Fix path: load() now stamps every booking row with _noMap:true, and the consumer (mapShipments) double-guards with typeof checks on origin.lat and destination.lat before handing rows to MapView. Reproduction in preview: visit /tracking after Quick Sign In — no overlay, no lat/undefined pageerror, map renders 53 markers, search finds bookings by booked_id and carrier name.
